propositions: Five per-extra matrix jobs plus one union job currently consume 6 concurrent slots and hold them for setup overhead, causing queue delays when the org reaches its 20-concurrent-job limit.
The current matrix list and _optional.EXTRAS are misaligned: mcp is in the matrix but not EXTRAS (no detection probe), while metrics is in EXTRAS but has no per-extra CI job.
Collapsing into a single venv-loop job with fresh venv per iteration eliminates redundant setup overhead and adds metrics coverage, reducing peak concurrent slots from 6 to 1.
The loop must use absolute venv-path invocations and error accumulation to avoid silent failures from stacked activations or ambient interpreter use.
The snapshot file infra/github/main-protection.snapshot.json hard-codes removed check names and must be updated to prevent emergency rollbacks from freezing main.
